registration.server: AddLatticeMcp registers the streamable-HTTP MCP server and installs per-session permission-scoped tool discovery.
registration.endpoint: MapLatticeMcp maps the MCP transport at LatticeApiMcpOptions.TransportPattern and applies RequireAuthorization by default.
registration.authorization_gate: CredentialStampingTool enforces ILatticeApiMcpAuthorizer at invocation, stamps caller credentials and active tenant, resolves optional region, and translates faults. RequireAuthorization controls endpoint authentication only; it does not bypass the default-deny authorizer.
registration.unknown_argument_rejection: CredentialStampingTool rejects undeclared tool arguments as client errors and echoes only sanitized, length-capped argument names with a bounded count.
registration.write_opt_in: Mutating tool modules are contributed only by their enableWrites, enableControl, enableAdministration, enableSchemaControl, enableLifecycle, or equivalent opt-in flags.
registration.region_parameter: CredentialStampingTool advertises an optional region string on tool calls. Facade-backed tools resolve it through the group router and reject unknown or unreachable targets fail-closed; app-contributed tools are in-process and accept only the current region.
registration.app_tool_surface: AddAppMcpTools registers ILatticeApiMcpAppToolSource. Enabled app manifests declare app-local tools, providers implement those names, and the session advertises permitted tools as {slug}_{tool}; app tools are omitted from lattice_capabilities.
registration.app_tool_authorization: AppMcpToolSource offers an app tool only when the caller holds the tool's declared role by binding (a group in its closure is bound to the role) and the access gate, asked only after the binding holds, refuses none of the role's operations on at least one resolved role scope; the caller's other rules never add a role. AppMcpNamespacedTool repeats the same check at invocation.
registration.app_tool_pairing: AppMcpToolActivation hard-fails an app's whole tool activation when a declared tool lacks an implementation, an implementation is undeclared, a local name is duplicated, or the slug is reserved.

grpc.marshalling: MCP tools are structured JSON over streamable HTTP; remote facade routing may use gRPC behind the MCP binding but no MCP operation is itself a gRPC method.

request.notes: Restore mode. InPlace (default): an HLC-preserving last-writer-wins merge into the live tree that heals missing or stale entries (a captured entry wins only when its clock is newer than, or the key is absent from, the live tree) and therefore never overwrites data that is newer live - it is a convergent repair, NOT a rollback.
